LanguageData.SkillIcons.AnimatedDesc: On: supported passions animate in the pawn creation screen, the Bio skill list and the Work tab.\nOff: the whole set stays fully static, including in the gallery below.
LanguageData.SkillIcons.ShowNoneDesc: Vanilla draws nothing at all when a pawn has no passion for a skill. Turn this on to draw a faint hollow heart instead.\n\nOff by default: that empty space is what lets you spot the skills that matter at a glance.
LanguageData.SkillIcons.WorkTabColourDesc: Always draw the full-colour icon, whatever the passion's state.
LanguageData.SkillIcons.WorkTabGreyDesc: Always draw the two-grey work tab variant. This is how Vanilla Skills Expanded behaves.
LanguageData.SkillIcons.WorkTabMixedDesc: Colour when the learning bonus is live - either the passion is currently triggered, or its bonus is permanent. Grey when it is dormant.\n\nThis reuses what the icon set already means: steel says the bonus is asleep. The grid then tells you which bonuses are actually running.
LanguageData.SkillIcons.GalleryHint: Every passion, twice: on the left as it appears in the skill list, on the right as it appears in the work tab. Animated ones play here at the speed set above.
